Privacy Policy for Sevo Partner

Technician & Service Partner Mobile Application | Effective Date: August 2026 | Last Updated: August 22, 2026

Summary: This Privacy Policy governs how CALDIM ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED ("Company", "we", "us", or "our") collects, processes, protects, and handles the personal, telemetry, and operational data of certified technicians, engineers, and contractor partners using the Sevo Partner mobile application.

📍 Prominent Disclosure: Real-Time & Background Location Access

Sevo Partner collects location data to enable:

  • Real-time automated job matching and dispatch based on technician proximity to customer locations.
  • Live navigation and accurate Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) updates for customers awaiting your arrival.
  • Turn-by-turn routing during active jobs marked as "On the Way".

When is Location collected? Location data is collected ONLY when you are actively Clocked In on shift or navigating to an assigned customer job, including when the app is running in the background or closed. Location tracking is immediately suspended whenever you Clock Out, take a break, or go offline.

2. Data We Collect from Technicians & Partners

To register, verify qualifications, dispatch bookings, and settle earnings, Sevo Partner collects:

  • Identity & KYC Information: Full legal name, mobile phone number, profile photo, government ID proof (Aadhaar / Driving License / Voter ID / PAN), emergency contact, and physical residential address.
  • Professional & Trade Credentials: Technical certifications, trade diplomas, skill matrices, tools & equipment ownership, and calibration accreditations.
  • Financial & Settlement Data: Bank account number, IFSC code, UPI ID, PAN number (for statutory TDS deduction and weekly payout settlements).
  • Operational & Field Records: Clock-in/out timestamps, active shift logs, customer job acceptance history, pre-service diagnostic photos, post-service completion photos, service notes, and digital customer signature logs.
  • Device Telemetry: Device hardware model, OS version, battery percentage (to ensure dispatch reliability), network status, app logs, and crash diagnostics.

3. Device Permissions & Purpose

In accordance with Google Play Store guidelines, Sevo Partner requires the following permissions:

Permission Purpose & Operational Scope
Access Fine & Coarse Location (Foreground & Background) Required to calculate distance to customer locations, offer nearby dispatch requests, and provide live customer map tracking while navigating to an assigned service job. Suspended automatically when Clocked Out or Offline.
Camera & Media / Storage Required during onboarding to upload KYC/ID documents, and during active service to capture pre/post diagnostic "Proof of Work" photos and invoice attachments.
Post Notifications Required to receive instant incoming job alerts, schedule changes, customer cancellation notifications, and payout confirmations.
Foreground Service Required to maintain reliable GPS telemetry tracking and prevent battery optimization from killing active route navigation while en-route to customer premises.

4. How We Use Partner Data

We process collected data exclusively for workforce management and service operations:

  • To verify technical qualifications, conduct background checks, and onboard certified partners.
  • To automatically calculate routing and dispatch proximity-matched service requests.
  • To display your professional profile (First Name, verified badge, rating, profile photo) to assigned customers.
  • To compute accurate pay statements, commission settlements, incentives, and tax deductions.
  • To resolve warranty claims, audit service quality, and protect platform safety.

5. Data Privacy, Tenant Isolation & Masking

Customer-Facing Privacy Masking: When navigating to a job, customers can view your live vehicle location and first name. As soon as the job is marked as completed, cancelled, or closed, the live tracking session is instantly terminated and coordinates are masked to safeguard technician privacy.

Multi-Tenant Security: All partner records are encrypted in transit via TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256 in dedicated relational PostgreSQL database architectures.

6. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell partner information to advertisers or marketing agencies. Data is shared strictly with:

  • Customers: Only essential details (Technician Name, Photo, Rating, Live GPS during active dispatch).
  • Banking Partners: For processing direct-to-bank settlement transfers and payouts.
  • Legal & Regulatory Authorities: Where mandated by law, court order, or official investigation.

7. Account Deletion & Right to Erase Data

Partners may request account closure, deactivation, or personal data deletion at any time:

  • In-App: Go to Profile → Settings → Privacy & Data → Request Account Deletion.
  • Web Form: Visit Account Deletion Request Portal.
  • Email: Write to support@caldimengg.in specifying your registered phone number.

Note: Statutory accounting and tax records (such as completed payout invoices and TDS filings) will be retained as required by Indian tax legislation before final purge.
